body.message:
Here's the Urban Oasis 2BR listing: https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/plp/rent/apartment-for-rent-dubai-business-bay-urban-oasis-67437566.html

That one is AED 8,500/month, which is above your ceiling. To be straight with you, we don't have a 2BR within AED 5,000 to 5,500. Our most affordable 2BR is AED 7,000/month at Elite Business Bay, fully all-inclusive.

Within your budget, the closest we have is a studio in Bayz by Danube at AED 4,400/month or a studio in Binghatti Azure in JVC at AED 5,000/month. Both fully all-inclusive.

I don't want to waste your time, and I understand this isn't what you were hoping for. Would either of the studios be worth a look, or is a 2BR a firm requirement?
